text: Path for the new key: paste it in Settings > APIs (SportsGameOdds); the app seals it and sends it to the GitHub secret SGO_API_KEY by itself, and the engine restarts to read it (several keys can be comma-separated and it rotates). I also fixed a bug: the dead key's 403 'Inactive API key' was treated as a harmless plan error, so nothing told you; it now counts as a refused key (tries your next key and raises a 'fix' notice). The engine already uses SGO the fast way (oddID + bookmakerID filters, alternates, cursor paging, props, closes, scores, injuries). Real-time streaming exists only on SGO's All-Star plan; once your new key is in I'll read its plan tier and tell you what it allows.
